Лизин.about: Lysine for herpes labialis: A 2015 Cochrane review (32 RCTs) found no evidence of prevention; safe, but no effect shown.
Лизин.caution: In the review, antiviral AEs were not increased; Lyzin - no recorded AEs, but no effect.
Лизин.food_sources: Meat, fish, eggs, legumes, cheese; the diet is not understood in abstracts; deficits in normal nutrition have not been described.
Лизин.guidelines: Cochrane 2015 (32 RCT, n=2640): Lysine was not found to be effective in preventing herpes; Long-term oral antivirals reduce relapses, but the benefit is small.
Лизин.how_to_choose: Do not choose Lysin for the prevention of herpes - there is no data; If there are frequent relapses, discuss antiviral medications with your doctor.
mechs: Lysin and prevention of recurrence of herpes on the lips
Long-term suppressive antiviral therapy as a basis for prevention
reduction in relapses, clinical benefit is small
Лизин.myths: “Lysine prevents herpes” - Cochrane 2015: no evidence. “Natural means it works” - relapses are reduced by antivirals, not Lysine. “More Lysin will heal faster” has not been studied.
Лизин.name: Lysine
Лизин.onset: No data: A 2015 review did not confirm the effectiveness of lysine for prevention.
Лизин.title: Lysine
Лизин.who_needs: People with recurrent herpes on the lips who are expecting prophylaxis from Lyzin - effectiveness has not been confirmed; in case of relapses, antiviral drugs are effective (clinical benefit is small).
